title: Updated views find an understandable rule

captions.emotions: Feeling supported by a shared principle

meaning: Your shared view can retain support when a changed arrangement receives a principled explanation that both people understand.
text: A familiar principle sometimes becomes clearer after an arrangement changes. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating an explanation when conditions shift. The Emperor in energy supports wanting dependable grounds for understanding. The Hierophant in emotions feels supported by a shared principle. You may feel comfortable when a new picture gains an understandable rule. Your view preserves connections between earlier and present arrangements, showing what actually changed and which principle helps you read the material without relying on habit alone.

Suppose you examine a library catalogue after its sections have been reordered. A familiar position now contains different subjects. **An understandable principle can support an updated view.** You change your explanation of the arrangement and notice how the new order connects headings with broad groups. It feels pleasing to see a rule accessible to both. It explains change while preserving memory of the earlier structure. Your view no longer treats an unfamiliar position as arbitrary and can name why one section now sits beside another.

The risk is requiring the new rule to explain every catalogue detail because it feels dependable. A particular exception starts looking like the loss of all support. Wanting stable grounds preserves proportion: a shared principle already connects sections while some details may still have their own reasons for placement.
